Integrations/ComplyAdvantage

ComplyAdvantage alert review automation with Verkflo agents

Verkflo agents screen names in ComplyAdvantage as a step in your procedure and bring back the listed entry behind each hit, so a reviewer sees the match and the customer file together.

Integration

What the ComplyAdvantage connection does

  • Actions

    • complyadvantage.search_entity screens a name against sanctions, PEP and adverse media.

    • complyadvantage.get_hit fetches a screening hit with the listed entry.

  • Where runs use it

    Onboarding checks, owner screening in KYB, counterparty screening before a first payment and vendor checks.

  • Credentials and records

    Your ComplyAdvantage API key lives in the vault, and steps hold a reference to it. Each call is recorded against the run.

How a screening step works

A step calls complyadvantage.search_entity with the name from the customer record. If results come back, complyadvantage.get_hit fetches each listed entry so the agent can compare it with your record and draft a note on what matches and what differs.

A CEL rule decides what happens next. A possible match goes to a named reviewer, and their decision and reason are logged with the hit.

Setting it up

A workspace Admin adds the ComplyAdvantage connection and stores the API key in the vault. Eval scenarios, such as a known list name and a near miss, run in the sandbox before a version goes live.

Screening appears across AML automation and KYC automation. Applicant data comes from the Sumsub integration.

ComplyAdvantage integration questions

Does Verkflo replace ComplyAdvantage?

No. ComplyAdvantage stays your screening source. Verkflo runs the review procedure around each search and hit.

Do we need our own ComplyAdvantage account?

Yes. Verkflo calls ComplyAdvantage with your API key, held in the vault.

Can the agent dismiss a hit?

Whether a hit is a true match is a reviewer's call. The agent compares the listed entry with your record and drafts a note, then the run waits for a named reviewer. The connection does not change anything in ComplyAdvantage today.

Trademark note

ComplyAdvantage is a trademark of its owner. Verkflo connects to ComplyAdvantage with your own account and API key. This page does not imply a partnership, endorsement or marketplace listing.
